newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes black barley for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes black barley for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) is offering 100,000 tonnes of black feed barley from 1995 crops for sale, an official spokesman said on Monday.
He told Reuters that an international call for prices had already been issued and that October 15 was set as final date to receive price offers. Confirmation would be made on October 16.
He said 50,000 tonnes would be ready for shipment in November and the remaining 50,000 tonnes in December.
